lines.text: Photos now runs Starfish v0.2 on a faster Winograd GPU path with guided lens-fringe cleanup for sharper, cleaner exports.
A new Luma curve in Edit adjusts brightness without shifting colour, and all curves stay smooth without overshooting.
Sharpening adapts toward frame corners and stopped-down apertures while keeping hard edges free of halos.
Export adds an optional Ultra 4× mode in Output when you want maximum detail from every pixel.
